description: This file implements a database driver class for Firebird in PHP, specifically extending ADOConnection to provide Firebird-specific database connection, transaction, sequence, blob, and metadata handling functionalities. It defines the ADODB_firebird class for database interactions and ADORecordset_firebird for result set handling, encapsulating Firebird-specific SQL syntax, error handling, and database features.

classes.name: ADODB_firebird
classes.description: The main database driver class for Firebird, providing methods for connecting, transactions, sequences, blobs, and metadata operations tailored for Firebird databases.

classes.name: ADORecordset_firebird
classes.description: A recordset class for Firebird, extending base ADORecordSet, allowing fetching and handling query results with support for metadata and blobs.

methods.name: setTransactionMode
methods.description: Sets the transaction isolation level for the Firebird connection.

methods.name: _connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the Firebird database with optional persistence.

methods.name: _pconnect
methods.description: Establishes a persistent connection to the Firebird database.

methods.name: metaPrimaryKeys
methods.description: Retrieves primary key(s) for a specified table.

methods.name: serverInfo
methods.description: Returns information about the Firebird server, including version and dialect.

methods.name: beginTrans
methods.description: Starts a new transaction.

methods.name: commitTrans
methods.description: Commits the current transaction.

methods.name: _affectedrows
methods.description: Returns the number of rows affected by the last operation.

methods.name: rollbackTrans
methods.description: Rolls back the current transaction.

methods.name: metaIndexes
methods.description: Retrieves indexes on a specific table.

methods.name: rowLock
methods.description: Locks specific rows in a table for update.

methods.name: createSequence
methods.description: Creates a new sequence in the database.

methods.name: genID
methods.description: Generates and returns a new sequence ID, creating the sequence if necessary.

methods.name: selectDB
methods.description: Placeholder for database selection, not applicable for Firebird.

methods.name: _handleError
methods.description: Handles and stores the last error message and code.

methods.name: errorNo
methods.description: Returns the last error number.

methods.name: errorMsg
methods.description: Returns the last error message.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Prepares an SQL statement for execution.

methods.name: _query
methods.description: Executes an SQL query or prepared statement.

methods.name: _close
methods.description: Closes the current database connection.

methods.name: metaColumns
methods.description: Retrieves metadata about columns of a specified table.

methods.name: metaTables
methods.description: Retrieves metadata about tables in the database.

methods.name: blobEncode
methods.description: Encodes and stores a blob in the database.

methods.name: blobDecode
methods.description: Decodes a blob's raw data.

methods.name: _blobDecode
methods.description: Automatically decodes blob data fetched from the database.

methods.name: updateBlobFile
methods.description: Updates a blob column using a file.

methods.name: updateBlob
methods.description: Updates a blob column with binary data.

methods.name: sqlDate
methods.description: Generates a database-specific SQL date string.

methods.name: offsetDate
methods.description: Creates an offset date SQL expression.

methods.name: selectLimit
methods.description: Executes a query with a limit and offset.
